from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RegionalDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """Housing start SAAR values for one month from one report, with report metadata for precedence."""
    report_date: str = Field(description="Release date of the report in YYYY-MM-DD format")
    month: str = Field(description="The month this data represents, YYYY-MM format")
    northeast: float | None = Field(description="SAAR for Northeast region in thousands of units")
    midwest: float | None = Field(description="SAAR for Midwest region in thousands of units")
    south: float | None = Field(description="SAAR for South region in thousands of units")
    west: float | None = Field(description="SAAR for West region in thousands of units")
    status: str | None = Field(description="Whether values are preliminary or revised")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    regional_data_points: list[RegionalDataPoint]
